disclaimer: This is general awareness information, not legal advice. Laws and procedures can change. Verify current requirements with official sources or qualified legal professionals.

documents.title: PECA awareness
documents.body: Pakistan’s Prevention of Electronic Crimes framework addresses certain online offences. Procedures, agencies, and definitions change. Confirm current law and reporting routes with official sources. This app does not file cases for you.

documents.title: Cyber stalking (awareness)
documents.body: Persistent unwanted digital contact can be a safety and legal issue. Preserve evidence. Seek qualified advice for your situation.

documents.title: Identity information misuse
documents.body: Misuse of CNIC, photos, or account identifiers should be documented. Report through official channels when you can connect.

documents.title: Privacy-related harms
documents.body: Unauthorized sharing of private data or images should be preserved as evidence. Do not pay to 'take down' content without independent advice.

documents.title: Online threats
documents.body: Credible threats to physical safety require urgent local help. The app cannot contact authorities while offline.

documents.title: Reporting processes
documents.body: Typical steps: preserve evidence, secure accounts, prepare a complaint, use official portals or helplines when online.

documents.title: Evidence preservation (legal awareness)
documents.body: Keep originals. Record hashes. Note date, time, platform, and how you obtained the file. Do not edit originals.
